message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried lasagna noodles | 12–15 sheets (or one box of no-boil noodles) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef or Italian sausage | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper, oregano, basil, red‑pepper flakes | to taste |
| | Optional: Red wine, bay leaf, carrot & celery (finely diced) | as desired |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 (beaten) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 tbsp (60 g) |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 tbsp (30 g) |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: Extra mozzarella or provolone | ½ cup (50 g) |

**Optional extras**  
- Sautéed spinach or kale (about 2 cups)  
- Sliced mushrooms (1 cup)  
- Roasted red peppers (½ cup)  

Enjoy building your lasagna!
